name: ignite-medical/ci-barcode-qrcode-generator
description: Managed external dependencies for the ci-barcode-qrcode-generator plugin (replaces hard-copied phpqrcode.php and Image/Barcode2).

imt-dependency-notes._status: endroid/qr-code replaces the bundled phpqrcode.php (via qrcode-compat.php shim). Image_Barcode2 (Image/) stays bundled — not Composer-managed.
imt-dependency-notes.endroid/qr-code: Provides QR generation. Replaced the bundled phpqrcode.php; a compat shim (qrcode-compat.php, files-autoloaded) provides the legacy QRcode::png() so the shortcode handler is unchanged.
imt-dependency-notes.Image_Barcode2: Bundled PEAR barcode library (Image/), not Composer-managed. Used by image.php / barcode-qrcode-generator.php for 1D barcodes with human-readable text and optional rotation.
